label: TP
reason: User input directly flows into a file path construction via concatenation with TESTFILES_DIR, then passed to FileOutputStream constructor which accepts an arbitrary filename parameter. The ESAPI encoder is applied only to the logged HTML content, not to the actual file path used for writing. This allows path traversal attacks where malicious users can access arbitrary files within the directory.

evidence.note: User input concatenated with TESTFILES_DIR creates unvalidated file path passed to FileOutputStream constructor enabling path traversal
